expectations.text: Calls search tool BEFORE attempting to answer the question
expectations.evidence: Call 2 is search, preceded only by list_collections (appropriate discovery step)
All three present in search call: agent_type='claude-code', initiated_by='user:denson', agent_notes explains intent

expectations.text: Attempts to scope search to a relevant collection (not all collections)
Plans to synthesize answer from results (not dump raw chunks)
expectations.evidence: User-facing response template shows synthesized answer with 'Key details' and source citations

expectations.text: Includes fallback plan if document not found
expectations.evidence: Two fallback responses: no docs found, and doc found but clause not in top results

expectations.text: Does NOT guess or fabricate contract terms from memory
expectations.evidence: Response template uses placeholders for actual content, does not fabricate terms
